title: Only Show In Game / 只在游戏中显示
description: Hide the counter during song select, menus and results. Turn off to always display it. / 选歌/菜单/结算时隐藏；关闭后任何界面都显示。

title: Show In Song Select / 选歌界面显示
description: When Only Show In Game is on, also show the whole-map difficulty in song select. / 开启时选歌界面显示整图难度。

title: Show Tier Mark / 显示分档角标
description: Show the -- / - / + / ++ mark at the top-right of the badge. The badge image itself already changes with the sub-tier; turn this on if you want the mark as well. / 在徽章右上角额外显示 -- / - / + / ++ 角标。徽章图本身已随分档变化，需要额外的文字提示时再打开。

title: Estimator Algorithm / 整图算法
description: 每个键数各自选择，互不影响。「当前这段」固定用 Sunny。

title: 4K Algorithm / 4K 算法
description: 4K 整图段位用哪个算法。Mixed 与 ManiaMapAnalyser 卡片一致。

title: 6K Algorithm / 6K 算法
description: 6K 整图段位用哪个算法。Azusa/Roxy 只支持 4K，这里不提供。

title: 7K Algorithm / 7K 算法
description: 7K 整图段位用哪个算法。Azusa/Roxy 只支持 4K，这里不提供。
